At Giati Etsi

Photos from the Google listing of the ouzeri.

Meze on the village square

Giati Etsi is an ouzeri and meze house at Apostolou Louka 3 in Aradippou. The tables stand on the square in front of the Church of Apostolos Loukas, and there is also a dining room inside. On its Facebook page the ouzeri promises meze, cold ouzo and live music with laika and rebetika every week on the square. The menu lists cold and hot meze, from tzatziki and dakos to octopus, sardines, halloumi in filo, spetsofai and slow-cooked lamb. Guests write about the atmosphere on the square, the live music and the polite staff.

The Google listing has no website, and the Facebook page links only to Instagram. Checked on 23 September 2026.
